svg.text: A real Claude Code session, sped up. The ticket comes with three rules.
Context window set small for the recording: it is already filling up.
Two follow-ups later there is 3% left before auto-compact.
Context full. exo-compact rebuilt it in 0.1 s: 67k tokens down to 4k.
The agent carries on with the same follow-up and finishes it.
Asked afterwards, it still lists the three rules from the first prompt.
